messages:
marta: Shiproom asked for a compact decision on rollout policy: who owns fallback chain vs. who controls circuit budgets for EU private. Need that by EOD.
oliver: Proposal: split responsibilities—infra owns soft variants (quantized/striped kernels), product owns prompt fallbacks, ops owns circuit enforcement.
tan: I'd like to add a "circuit budget" concept: each tenant gets N circuits per rolling window; if exceeded, exposure auto-decrements and tenant goes to cooldown. Helps avoid noisy neighbor thrash.
ops-bot: runbook note: any private rollout that could hit >2% SLA risk triggers oncall + runbook attach. Use /runbook attach circuit-budget-play.
oliver: Cadence idea: wave0 = 1% critical tenants, wave1 = 5% (after 45m), wave2 = 20% (after 3h). But expose by tier (critical, standard, developer) not random fraction.
tan: Circuit budget defs: default 3 circuits per 60m window. If a tenant hits budget, set exposure_fraction=0 for that tenant and mark rollback_reason. Auto-unfreeze after cooldown=120m or manual review.
safety-bot: safety gate: if moderation hits >0.25% or safety-filter blocks increase >0.4% in the A/B cohort, auto-hold and notify safety.
marta: Flag prototype (compact):
```
flags.rollout.eu_private_v2 = {
  waves: [ {tier:"critical",frac:0.01}, {tier:"standard",frac:0.05}, {tier:"broad",frac:0.20} ],
  warmup_mins: 30,
  bump_policy: ["0.05 after 45m","0.20 after 3h"],
  per_tenant_cap_rps: 50,
  circuit_budget: {limit:3, window_mins:60, cooldown_mins:120},
  fallback_order: ["striped-quant","prompt-simplify","token-cap-150","global-kill"],
  telemetry_gates: ["kms_ok","p95_gate","ab_safety"],
  manual_review_after: "warmup+15m"
}
```
oliver: Also propose an "auto-throttle" rule: if p95 crosses threshold for 10m, reduce wave exposure by 50% and extend warmup by 30m.
ops-bot: scheduled-task: kms-preflight at 1955556840. Fail -> hold + alert #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: /deploy canary requires approvals: product + security + infra.
tan: Action items:
- oliver: implement flag + fallback mapping (owner)
- tan: add circuit-budget enforcement and telemetry tags (owner)
- ops: confirm KMS preflight + per-tenant cap enforcement (owner)
- safety-bot: finalize safety auto-hold thresholds (owner)
Timeline: kms-preflight 1955556840, warmup target 1955557020, first bump window +45m after warmup.
marta: OK. I'll summarize for shiproom. Speak now if objections to circuits=3/window or tiered waves. :thumbsup:
